setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A scientist speculates that outsiders might possess instruments that interpret stars, diagnose illness, or suggest decisions.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: An imagined instrument spots a pattern the observers overlooked.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A mistaken calibration produces a confident but false answer.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A healer refuses to act on a mysterious recommendation without understanding its limits.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A novice admits that even familiar instruments can be useful before their workings are fully understood.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council imagines using the instrument as one voice among many.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A tired worker wonders whether people might surrender responsibility to a tool that sounds certain.
